page_title: BUR 1-3 AST | Burnley v Aston Villa 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Michael Salisbury has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) does well to meet a cross from Josh Cullen, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post.
88' The linesman signals that Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
86' Here is a change. Ollie Watkins is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch so that Douglas Luiz can be given a rest.
86' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
83' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

82' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' Close! Matty Cash (Aston Villa) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
81' Today's match ends for Lyle Foster who will be replaced by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).
81' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Zeki Amdouni.
81' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Bertrand Traore (Aston Villa) replaces Lucas Digne.
80' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
78' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
77' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
76' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
76' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) works the corner short.
75' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. Aston Villa get a corner.
74' Nathan Redmond (Burnley) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) will replace Moussa Diaby.

72' Burnley slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
68' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Luca Koleosho is replaced by Nathan Redmond (Burnley).
68' It is time for a substitution. Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) is on for Sander Berge.
65' Aston Villa hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
63' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) passes the ball onto Ollie Watkins, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.

61' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) fires a brilliant volley into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Lucas Digne provided the assist. What a finish! 1:3.
60' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

60' Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. The referee points to the corner flag and Burnley will take a corner.
59' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
59' Sander Berge (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Matty Cash is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa).
54' Sander Berge (Burnley) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
51' Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
51' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
50' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Burnley have a corner.

47' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Lyle Foster (Burnley) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Johann Berg Gudmundsson. The score is now 1:2.
46' Half-time substitution. Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) is replaced by Johann Berg Gudmundsson.
46' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Sander Berge (Burnley) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.

40' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
40' Aston Villa are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
39' Josh Cullen (Burnley) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
38' A pass into the box finds Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by James Trafford denies him.
36' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
36' There's an opportunity for John McGinn (Aston Villa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
35' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. Aston Villa will take a corner kick.
31' Lyle Foster (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Burnley take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
31' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) brings an opponent down and Michael Salisbury interrupts the game. Burnley are awarded a free kick.
27' Sander Berge (Burnley) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
24' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
24' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

23' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from Aston Villa as they win a corner.

20' 0 - 2 What a goal! Moussa Diaby plays it to Matty Cash (Aston Villa), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past James Trafford into the right side of the goal. 0:2.
17' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is flagged for offside.
17' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
13' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.

10' What a poor attempt! Luca Koleosho (Burnley) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
8' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Ollie Watkins plays it into the box, and Matty Cash (Aston Villa) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 0:1.
6' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
6' Connor Roberts (Burnley) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
5' A cross into the box from Lyle Foster (Burnley) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
4' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is able to continue to play.
3' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The first half has just begun.
Aston Villa will kick the game off.
Michael Salisbury is introduced as the referee for today's match.
